about: Tier 0 asset budgets, read from files only (tools/tier0/budgets.mjs). Per-asset caps, the summed resident-texture ledger and the summed shipped-size ledger. Line figures are the plan's estimates; the totals are the caps. Paths are repo-relative prefixes (no globs).

hero.about: Brea as worn: the body plus one outfit or armour rung, LOD 0.

npc.about: Near-tier person (LOD 0 meshes plus any unsuffixed mesh such as a shadow caster). Atlas carriers and the clip pack are not bodies.

instruments.about: Each Instrument model needs a size class; the caps are per class.

textures.about: Largest edge of any shipped texture. Uncompressed textures stay at 1024 until KTX2 (M0.10) is in the build; KTX2 textures may be 2048.

resident.about: Resident texture memory if every shipped texture is resident at once (no streaming exists yet), identical images counted once. RGBA8 with mips for PNG/JPEG/WebP, 8 bpp with mips for KTX2. Textures built at runtime (sky, LUTs, UI canvases) are not on disk and are not counted.

lines.label: people: heads, bodies and outfit atlases

shipped.about: Bytes that ship: public/ (tracked + untracked-not-ignored) plus the built JS and CSS. With no region streaming yet, the first load is everything the game can fetch at boot, so the static first-load figure is the whole of it; the boot, when it runs, measures what was actually transferred.
